text:
Maya (CEO): thanks for the Qs in today's all-hands. a few quick clarifications on partner incentives, pipeline hygiene, and next steps.
Aria (GTM): quick one 505: what are the incentive tiers for partners on closed-won? were we finalizing %s today?
Noor (RevOps): current proposal: Tier A strategic = 10% rebate + co-sell credit, Tier B regional = 6% rebate, Tier C integrations = 3% referral. numbers are draft until legal signs off.
Liam (Sales): will rebates be paid on ARR or first-year ACV? reps need clarity for forecasting.
Noor (RevOps): rebates = first-year ACV. renewals handled separately in year 2+ compensation plans. will update comp doc.
Zoe (Marketing): are there partner-facing success stories or sheets we can hand to reps? partners asked for case studies when pitching.
Aria (GTM): marketing is compiling 3 short case studies (SaaS, fintech, marketplace) plus an ROI cheat sheet. ETA Tue.
Maya (CEO): pipeline hygiene ask from leadership: please ensure all partner-sourced opps have `partner_source` tag + partner name in deal notes. this helps routing and attribution.
Liam (Sales): adding: when partner gives an intro, we should set lead status to `partner-qualified` and include the intro transcript if available.
Noor (RevOps): RevOps will add a validation check in CRM: missing `partner_source` will block stage advancement to Demo. small automation to reduce manual errors.
Aria (GTM): question re: demo cadence for partner-introduced leads: should partner join initial demo or wait for SQL? some partners prefer to co-present.
Maya (CEO): default = AE leads first demo. if partner requests co-demo, mark as `co-demo` and coordinate with partner ops. strategic partners = auto invite.
Liam (Sales): tiny ask: can we get a one-click invite template (calendar + partner script) so reps don't write new emails each time?
Zoe (Marketing): creating calendar templates + two partner email templates: 1) intro, 2) follow-up with collateral link. will drop in #sales-ops by EOD Thu.
DevBot: CRM rule update pushed to staging at 1865004400: `partner_source` validation added.
Noor (RevOps): also running a small audit on existing opps this week to retro-tag partners. will share numbers in #revops.
Aria (GTM): one more on measurement: how are we tracking partner-influenced pipeline? is it multi-touch?
Noor (RevOps): multi-touch attribution for marketing-sourced influences, but for partner-sourced deals primary attribution will be `partner_source` on creation. we can report multi-touch separately.
Maya (CEO): action items: 1) finalize incentive % with legal (Noor/Legal) 2) templates + case studies (Zoe/Marketing) 3) demo + co-demo flow doc + calendar template (Aria/Sales) 4) CRM validation + retro tagging (Noor). I want a short playbook draft by next Mon.
Liam (Sales): happy to pilot the playbook with west-coast reps. 20-30m feedback session?
Aria (GTM): scheduling poll now. thanks all.
DevBot: Reminder: partner-playbook draft created at 1865004720 and posted to #product-docs.
